Name: Toggle Crops and Artisan Goods - Expanded - Wildflour - Cornucopia and more
Author: zombifier
Description:
Do you use multiple different crops and artisan good mods and is somewhat annoyed by the necessarily duplicate items between them, as well as machine/cooking recipes that can only use one or the other? This mod adds a quickfix by allowing you to toggle between them; by default, pressing Q will transform the currently held fruit/vegetable/artisan goods/etc. in your hand from one mod's variant to the other.
